tasks.subject: Task 1: Scaffold namespace + Flux Kustomization
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Créer le namespace media, le kustomization.yaml racine, et enregistrer la Flux Kustomization CRD.

**Files:**
- Create: kubernetes/apps/media/namespace.yaml
- Create: kubernetes/apps/media/kustomization.yaml
- Create: kubernetes/apps/media.yaml
- Modify: kubernetes/apps/kustomization.yaml

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] namespace media créé
- [ ] Flux Kustomization CRD valide avec dependsOn: infrastructure
- [ ] apps/kustomization.yaml référence media.yaml
- [ ] yamllint 0 erreur

**Verify:** `mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/apps/media/ kubernetes/apps/media.yaml`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["kubernetes/apps/media/namespace.yaml", "kubernetes/apps/media/kustomization.yaml", "kubernetes/apps/media.yaml", "kubernetes/apps/kustomization.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/apps/media/ kubernetes/apps/media.yaml", "acceptanceCriteria": ["namespace media créé", "Flux Kustomization CRD valide", "yamllint 0 erreur"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: PVs et PVCs NFS partagés pour les médias
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Créer les PVs/PVCs NFS statiques ReadWriteMany pour downloads/movies/tv/music/books.

**Files:**
- Create: kubernetes/apps/media/nfs-volumes.yaml

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 5 PVs + 5 PVCs ReadWriteMany
- [ ] yamllint 0 erreur

**Verify:** `mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/apps/media/nfs-volumes.yaml`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["kubernetes/apps/media/nfs-volumes.yaml"], "verifyCommand": "mise exec -- yamllint kubernetes/apps/media/nfs-volumes.yaml", "acceptanceCriteria": ["5 PVs NFS", "5 PVCs ReadWriteMany", "yamllint 0 erreur"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```
